No primeiro dia, os estudantes devem responder a 45 questões de Linguagens e Códigos e 45 de Ciências Humanas, além da redação. How to make Green Apple Ice Cream Apple 🍏: Peel, core, and cut 5 Granny Smith apples into small chunks. Add the apples, 30 g water, 80 g sugar, and 10 g lemon juice to a saucepan. Cook over medium heat until the apples are completely soft, then blend until smooth. Transfer the apple puree to a shallow container. Stir in the juice of 1 lemon and ¼ cup of sugar, then freeze overnight until completely solid. (The first addition of 10g lemon juice prevents the apples from browning, while the second addition of one lemon juice is for adding a tangy flavor.) The next day, whip 200 g heavy cream, 60 g sweetened condensed milk, and 1 tsp vanilla extract until stiff peaks form. Use a fork to scrape the frozen apple puree into fine flakes. Add the flakes to the whipped cream and gently mix until evenly combined. Transfer the mixture to an airtight container and freeze overnight before serving. ❤ #tiktokrecipecontest #icecream #dessert #fruit #homecooking
